quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 earnings deck, backlog slide (page 6): A&D long-term program backlog of $2.0B was up from $1.5B a year ago and included these significant Q3'26 bookings: 'Surface ship surveillance Spy-6 radar', 'APS-143 maritime surveillance radar', 'Golden Dome' and 'Multiple Restricted Programs'. Total 90-day backlog was $1.3B versus $0.6B a year earlier ('grew 117% year over year'); book-to-bill was 2.13 versus 1.15 a year ago. Sector slide (page 7): Commercial revenue up 91%+ year over year with a commercial book/bill ratio of 2.5; A&D proposal activity and backlog 'at all time highs', with radar and restricted-program momentum in bookings 'while munitions demand signals still improving'.
quarterly_data.figure: A&D program backlog $2.0B (from $1.5B); 90-day backlog $1.3B (+117% YoY); book-to-bill 2.13 (1.15 a year ago)
